[SWS_CM_80028] Checks for a received signal-based serialized event message
⌈
If SomeipEventDeployment.serializer is set to signalBased then
upon reception of a signal-based serialized event message the following checks shall
be conducted:
• Use the Service ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00040]) and the serviceInter-
faceId attribute of the SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment element in
the Manifest to determine the right ServiceInterface.
• Verify that the Event ID (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00040]) matches the eventId at-
tribute of one of the SomeipEventDeployments of the SomeipServiceIn-
terfaceDeployment which have the attribute SomeipEventDeployment.
serializer set to signalBased.
If any of the above checks fails the received signal-based event message shall
be discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the
ara::com implementation).
⌋
